g.text: Why a bigger J++ part costs the 27B lookup: can't tell
Extra loss (0-1): switches lost without the J++ part, minus those lost without a random part
(same size). Three causes, fixed in advance; none holds on the 27B. The lens reads identity: from
25 to 100 atoms identity answers fall 0.31 beyond the random part, but position answers fall
0.11 too (bar: under 0.1). The lens reads the pointer: the 100 atoms overlap it little (mean
cos² 0.02; with identity, the two items' mean difference, 0.29). Any 100 atoms would do: another
scene's cost the 27B lookup −0.01 [−0.04, 0.00] in the main test.
